steps.note: Start from the prepared RFQ Master QCS as required for this state.
Open the published RFQ participants list so the missing second bid can be entered for another invited vendor.
Create the second vendor's 90 bid to reproduce the two-bid setup without needing a second vendor portal session.
Confirm the surrogate bid was accepted.
Move to the invited vendor's separate supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this prepared RFQ in the vendor portal on its pricing round.
Submit the same vendor's revised price, lowering the original 100 bid to 90.
Return to the buyer's console to inspect the resulting bid data.
Open Responses to inspect the vendor bid trail and current response values.
Confirm both vendor responses are present, with one direct portal bid and one surrogate bid.
Verify the response history records one revision.
Verify the revised quote is identified as the current bid.
Verify the response view shows the revised price of 90.
Open Master QCS to verify the revised value used for comparison.
Confirm Master QCS contains both real vendor columns.
Verify the revised vendor's current RFQ rate is 90 in Master QCS.
